property_summary: After a successful fallback call (10 Ether sent, timestamp strictly greater than pastBlockTime), the contract's balance must either remain unchanged (transfer not triggered) or become zero (transfer triggered); the bug replaces 'block.number % 15' with 'block.timestamp % 15', causing the transfer to trigger at a different set of timestamps than the correct block-based condition, thus violating the rule that the balance outcome is a deterministic function of the true block number.
change_summary: Replace block.number with block.timestamp in the transfer condition to change the trigger from block-based to time-based.
